description.p: This is a community package of Cline, maintained independently and unaffiliated with Cline Bot Inc. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.
Cline is an AI coding agent. It reads your code, edits files, runs commands, and works through tasks with you in a project on your machine.

Permissions: network is granted because signing in, calling a model provider and opening the marketplace are the app itself. Display, GPU and the tray icon are granted too. Cline keeps its own sign-in and settings in ~/.cline, so that directory is created and kept. Nothing else on the system is granted. Projects outside ~/.cline stay out of reach until you opt in, and commands the agent starts run inside the sandbox, where your host git and compilers are not visible:

ul.li: Open projects in your home directory: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home bot.cline.app
